## Recent Developments (2026)

  **Claude Code Adoption and Revenue:** Claude Code has reached $2.5 billion in annual recurring revenue (ARR) one year after its launch. Internal data from Anthropic indicates that the tool, originally developed as the "Claude CLI," rapidly overtook all other internal coding tools between September and December of the previous year due to its design for longer model horizons. Boris Cherny, the creator of Claude Code, reported that 100% of his code contributions to the project over the last 30 days—including 259 PRs and 40,000 lines of code—were written by Claude Code (Opus 4.5). Anthropic's study "Measuring AI Agent Autonomy in Practice" found that the median Claude Code turn duration is approximately 45 seconds, while the 99.9th percentile turn duration increased from 25 minutes to 45 minutes between October and January. Usage patterns show that new users employ full auto-approval features roughly 20% of the time, a figure that doubles to approximately 40% for more experienced users.

  **Computer Use Feature Launch:** Anthropic released a feature allowing Claude to control the user's computer, including mouse, keyboard, and screen, to complete tasks in any application. Felix Riesberg of Anthropic stated: "Today we're releasing a feature that allows Claude to control your computer, mouse, keyboard, and screen, giving it the ability to use any app." The official announcement highlighted that Claude can open apps, navigate browsers, and fill in spreadsheets. The launch generated significant engagement, with the official announcement tweet receiving 40 million views and 62,000 bookmarks within 16 hours of posting.

  **Market Position and User Behavior:** In the January 2026 AI usage pulse survey, Claude was the primary AI model for 45.8% of respondents, surpassing ChatGPT (31%) and Gemini (16%), despite ChatGPT having broader overall reach (87% vs. Claude's 80%). Claude primary users reported significantly higher agentic AI usage (52%) and vibe coding adoption (87%) compared to ChatGPT primary users (24% and 52%, respectively).

  **Security and Market Impact:** The release of Anthropic's Claude Code Security plugin caused a significant drop in cybersecurity stocks, with CrowdStrike losing 8%, Okta losing 9%, and Cloudflare losing 7% in a single day. Additionally, Anthropic's Claude service experienced an outage on a Monday morning, peaking at 6:40 a.m., which the company attributed to unprecedented demand for the service over the preceding week.

  **Marketing and Branding:** Anthropic released its first-ever set of Super Bowl commercials, all of which focused on OpenAI's planned ads and closed with the tagline "Ads are coming, but not to Claude."
